definitions.conditionally_required: A mandatory requirement when the versioned closed inventory activates its declared substrate or source predicate.
definitions.deployment_required: A requirement activated by this subject's retained deployed workload or role.
definitions.mandatory_core: A universal Host Operational Portrait v1 requirement for the declared host role.
definitions.operator_loop_required: A required clean-install, recurrence, inspection, posture, notification, retention, backup, or product self-standing gate that is not necessarily a host fact.
definitions.optional_supported: A supported mechanism that is not itself a completeness obligation and cannot replace an underlying required question without explicit selection and qualification.
definitions.retirement_approved: An operator-approved successor disposition subject to stated prerequisites; it grants no execution, removal, cutover, or mutation authority.

implementation_authority_values.bounded_closure_unit_only: Records, design, evidence, and narrowly necessary implementation may address only identified blocker closure; no general implementation authority follows.
implementation_authority_values.none_in_this_decision: This ratification grants no implementation work for this row.

open_blockers.description: Exact versioned per-subject inventories, bounded membership rules, authoritative sources, exclusions, and expected diagnostic capabilities are not closed.
Labelwatch and Driftwatch observation, profile, phase, field, denominator, freshness, threshold, hysteresis, recovery, and consumer contracts are not frozen.
The non-colliding package, executable, service, configuration, state, socket, and documentation namespace is not selected.
Sushi-k's exact OS, architecture, runtime floor, and relevant platform capabilities are not bound.
Required endpoint/dependency roles, logical vantage identities, generations, request contexts, topology evidence, and qualification bases are not closed.

ratification_rules: Specification ratification does not establish subject completeness.
Every mandatory, deployment-required, operator-loop-required, and activated conditional row must pass its exact acceptance relation before subject completeness can be earned.
Optional provider absence does not excuse an underlying required diagnostic question.
Retirement approval grants no execution, deletion, purge, cutover, or authority-switch permission.
Missing, stale, refused, unsupported, partial, contradictory, or not-configured testimony cannot become healthy.
No row may infer authority, reliance, or independent corroboration from packaging, endpoint appearance, provider count, or producer assertion.
A focused conformance review may update row and subject verdicts without repeating R1-R11 unless it proposes a material specification change.

retirement_authority_values.conditional_disposition_only: The item may leave the successor obligation only after R10/R11 prerequisites; actual mutation requires separate authorization.

capabilities.operator_rationale: Labelwatch native progression, publication, coverage, bridge, and consumer testimony is required for the retained workload.
